compressionBenchmark.environment: Node.js 24.14.1 on Windows; each deterministic gzip shard decompressed and recompressed independently with Brotli quality 5

browserSearchBenchmark.environment: Playwright Chromium 151.0.7922.34, 1440x1000-equivalent desktop context, local production preview, new browser context per cold query
browserSearchBenchmark.measurementBoundary: Input fill through first visible Catalogue of Life result; includes the intentional 120 ms UI debounce, local HTTP fetch, checksum verification, Worker gunzip/NDJSON parse and React render

notes: Brotli is measured for feasibility only; the published runtime uses deterministic gzip to reuse the existing checksum-verifying Worker path.

The full runtime registry is lazy. The home/dashboard initial payload contains only the small current.json catalogue summary; the 928 KB catalogue manifest and one routed search shard load after a query reaches three characters. A resolving result additionally loads one SHA-256-routed target shard; exact-ID taxonomy and direct children each load one routed hierarchy shard.
Measurements describe this build machine and local preview, not a network-service-level guarantee.
